title: Q5
description:
“Today, if you will hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
Read: Psa 95 (whole psalm)
a) Psa 95 begins with a call to worship the Creator and Shepherd, then turns to warning. What does that whole psalm bring forward into Hebrews?
b) David wrote “Today” long after the wilderness. What does that let Hebrews say to its own readers?
